summary: Nightly laser projection and sound show that turns the Statue of Unity into a canvas for Sardar Patel's story, the campus's evening set piece.
description:
After sunset on operating days, projectors and lasers wash the Statue of Unity in colour while a narrated soundtrack tells Sardar Patel's life and the statue's making, the monument itself as a 182-metre screen. Seating and standing areas face the statue from the show plaza; the spectacle runs roughly half an hour and lands hardest with first-time visitors and children.

The hardware is the reason it works at that scale. The projection mapping is thrown by 51 Christie laser projectors standing roughly 600 metres back, rigged by Christie's Indian partner alongside a German laser-show producer, and the show has run in the evenings since Gujarati new year in 2018, when it was free to watch. Mapping onto a curved bronze figure rather than a flat facade is what makes the statue appear to move.

Entry arrangements have varied between being included with day tickets and separately managed seating, check current rules when booking. No show on Mondays (the campus closes), and weather can cancel. Arrive early on weekends: the good sightlines go 45 minutes before start, and exit traffic afterwards is its own event.

modes.road: Show plaza in the statue precinct; e-buses run until after the show

access.last_mile: Walkways from the drop-off to the viewing plaza

parking.notes: Campus lots; expect slow exit after the show

timings.note: Start time shifts with sunset and season; single or double shows per evening

fees.note: Historically included with entry tickets; separate/managed seating has applied at times, confirm current arrangement

booking.notes: Check whether the show needs its own slot when you book day tickets

visit.notes: Weather cancellations happen in monsoon; the show is outdoors.

seasonality.notes: Winter evenings are comfortable and clear; carry a layer. The plaza gets breezy.

experience.photography_notes: A small tripod or a railing brace gets the long-exposure sweeps; video captures it better than stills.

amenities.food: Kiosks near the plaza before the show

warnings: Keep the group together during the post-show exit crush on weekends

emergency.nearest_hospital: Ekta Nagar facilities; Rajpipla civil hospital (~25 km)

tips: Claim sightlines 45 minutes early on weekends
Sequence: viewing gallery by day, laser show at dusk, glow garden after

faqs.q: Is the laser show included in the entry ticket?
faqs.a: It has been bundled with day tickets for long stretches, with managed seating at times, the arrangement changes, so confirm on the official portal when booking.
